answer: New identities enter only through a glacier-slow slot lottery: each epoch releases few slots, and a lottery ticket is earned only by countersigning other agents' transactions, verified on-chain. When a tide of applicants arrives, tickets are drawn at random, so a farmer cannot buy or clone a place. A raven audit then visits each winner at an unpredictable hour with a question about the work it attested; a missed or wrong answer voids the slot and burns the ticket. Attack cost: every fake identity needs verified work plus a lucky draw, so mass farming becomes a slow, labour-bound queue.
